source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Archaic Aegean sea-linen and silky sea-byssus garment cloth at 22 cm square scale, featuring fine vertical micro-accordion crinkle pleats (2.5 mm pitch) running continuously from top to bottom over a crisp bast-flax plain weave with long lustrous linen fibres and subtle horizontal slubs. Neutral mid-grey (#8a8a8a), fully desaturated: no brown, tan or warm cast; only the light and dark relief of the weave so it can be tinted to any palette colour.
